name: USC Democracy and Fair Elections Lab (California Elections and Policy Poll)
sponsor: USC Dornsife Center for the Political Future (no political, corporate, or external sponsorship)

poll.source_locator: PDF p2 table 'who do you plan to vote for to be US House Representative? [no push on undecideds]': CA-22 Dem 52%, Rep 41%; page data (polls/ca-polling-2026.js initialBars): undecided 6, won't vote/skip 1
poll.notes: Headline = release table without pushing undecideds. Pushed-undecided version: Villegas 54, Valadao 44, skip 2 (https://www.thedemocracylab.com/ca-polling-2026 data file). 'Won't vote / skip' 1% not counted in other. n=356, MoE +/-5.2. NEW pollster_id.

pollster.weighting_quote: voter file sample (PDI); weights included party, race/ethnicity, gender, age, 2024 presidential vote recall, and vote propensity using previous vote validated data; universe set using PDI estimates of 2026 general electorate composition; raking (anesrake in R)
pollster.mode: email to probability-based voter-file sample in three districts, email and text in a fourth (district not specified)
pollster.method_owner: USC Democracy and Fair Elections Lab
